title: EVOTRACE: Evolutionary Trait Reconstruction and Causal Evidence
scientific_question: In a declared lineage and environment, what evidence supports the contributions of variation, selection, drift, migration, and developmental mechanism to evolutionary trait change?
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer selection from allele-frequency change alone.
